developing and implementing a fractional order controller for a quadrotor UAV, with the objective of improving the system performance.
the development of fractional order control theory and applications in real time control of a quadcopter.
the development of a new fractional order control approach to control a quadrotor system and the comparison of its performance with two integer order control strategies.

the fractional order controller has better control performance compared to integer order PD controller and similar control performance as MPC based controller but with lower computational burden and complexity.

the proposed fractional order controller is a good alternative to integer order control for path-following control of AR. Drone system.
the proposed fractional order PD controller can achieve better performance than the integer order controllers in terms of tracking error and robustness to model uncertainty.
the proposed fractional order PD controller is simple and effective and can be implemented on the AR. drone platform.
